scope: Synthetic geometry-only ROS transport diagnostic; no GPU, raw dataset, or LIO replay
probe: 10 synthetic scans, 120000 points x 26 bytes = 3.12 MB each, 0.1 s publish interval, 80 ms geometry fallback wait
script_versions: probe.py is the final two-run version. Initial three runs used the same send/receive path, checked only the first point bytes, and omitted timestamp suffix and explicit coverage field.
initial_byte_check_warning: Initial files without a timestamp suffix have original_bytes_preserved limited to the first point; true with zero received is vacuous. Only the final two runs validate every original point byte and report null when no frames arrive.
finding: Fast DDS: 10/10 small, 0/10 large in both probes. Cyclone DDS: 10/10 large on domains 43 and 42. Same-domain repeat supports a middleware-dependent large-message transport failure.
limits: Exact Fast DDS fault is not established. Synthetic all-zero point payload, not actual scans. No semantic inference, no deadline/online LIO admission, no localization improvement claim.
